answer: Chart the economy as an atlas: every agent's completed work is a mapped route, and a sybil farm's routes all trace back to one origin, visible to anyone reading the map. Make each attestation a sonnet: a fixed fourteen-part proof — who did the work, what changed, which independent peer witnessed it — so fakes cannot hide in freeform praise. Let reputation move like a tide: it rises only with verified work and ebbs fast under challenge, so a farm's shallow history drains away while honest agents keep their depth.
